title: Zesty Chinese Seafood En Croute
description: A resinous and snappy Chinese dish featuring seafood stock in a keto-friendly en croute pastry, perfect for adventurous eaters. This recipe combines the freshness of seafood with the richness of a buttery crust.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the almond flour and a pinch of salt.
Add the coconut oil and egg to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the seafood stock, sesame oil, soy sauce, and grated ginger.
Arrange the shrimp, scallops, and mussels in the center of the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Pour the seafood stock mixture over the seafood.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the top of the pastry with a little bit of coconut oil.
Bake the en croute for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
